item.title: BPKP Celebrates 5th NRB Day with the Bangladeshi Community
item.description: On 30 December, the Bangladesh Probashi Kallyan Parishad (BPKP) brought together over 600 guests at the prestigious Royal Regency Hall in Ilford to mark the 5th annual Non-Resident Bangladeshi (NRB) Day. The event was attended by UK parliamentarians, local councillors, advisors, and representatives from leading organisations supporting the Bangladeshi diaspora across the UK and Europe.
